sections.content: van ('there is / it exists') is used to state what's in stock or available. Several items are simply listed one after another, joined by és ('and') before the last one, with a single van at the end of the list.

items.spanish: Piros, kék, fekete és fehér van.
items.english: There's red, blue, black, and white.

sections.content: This is the same 'existence' van used for location -- never the identity copula. 'Piros van' announces that red is in stock; it does not mean 'it is red' (that would use zero copula: 'Ez piros.').
